text:
Astley Down hosted the annual Larkmere kite festival again this year, drawing 18,400 visitors over two days, organisers confirmed.

The 2025 edition ran 14-15 June, according to the published event calendar. A total of 212 kite flyers registered to take part.

The figures appear in the Larkmere Kite Guild's Annual Report 2025, presented at a press briefing at Astley Down Town Hall on 20 June.

Marguerite Oyelaran, Festival Director of the Larkmere Kite Guild, confirmed the town as host. "Astley Down is where the Larkmere festival takes place, and this year's turnout shows how much the event means to the community," she said.

The report sets out attendance and participation for the weekend. The Harbour Dispatch will report further details as they are released.
